prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=earth-zoom-out-ai) and add your photo (your photo). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the subject's face, facial features, skin tone, and hair exactly the same. Turn the photo into an authentic ultra-wide 0.5x phone selfie taken from slightly above head height: the subject stands alone in the middle of a wide sunny city plaza, looking up into the lens with a relaxed smile. Strong wide-angle distortion, head large in the upper center, plaza and rooftops curving away, big blue sky. Vertical 9:16. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: One continuous take with no cuts. Keep the person's face exactly as in the image. The person smiles and waves up at the lens. The camera rises smoothly backward and up, the person becomes a small dot in the plaza, the whole city spreads out below, then the coast and mountains, clouds slide past, the horizon curves, and the camera breaks into black space with the whole blue Earth hanging among the stars. Audio: plaza ambience, rising wind, a deep cinematic swell, then near silence. No text, no logos.
